item.title: The Anthropocene was rejected as a geological epoch—but the idea is still changing how we see the world
item.description: The Anthropocene became part of the zeitgeist after Nobel laureate Paul Crutzen launched the idea in 2000. This is the notion that a crescendo of human impacts has recently propelled Earth out of the relatively stable climatic conditions of the Holocene epoch, during which human civilization developed and flourished, to produce a new kind of planet. item.title: The surprising place where giant dinosaurs incubated their eggs
item.description: Finding a fossilized dinosaur egg is exceptionally rare, but finding a stash of more than 250 shell fragments in the chilly southern reaches of the planet is even more surprising. The discoveries come from southernmost Patagonia in Argentina, where giant, long-necked titanosaurs roamed toward the end of the dinosaur era. Previous egg discoveries suggested that these massive beasts usually nested much farther north. Fuente: Phys.org.

item.title: ¿Qué busca EE. UU. en Ecuador? Rubio refuerza la alianza antidrogas tras renovada ofensiva en el Pacífico
item.description: El secretario de Estado de EE. item.description: Teherán amplió además sus restricciones marítimas más allá de Ormuz, mientras una nueva ola de represalias golpeó buques e instalaciones militares y llevó el crudo nuevamente por encima de los US$100 Fuente: La Nación - El Mundo.
